# THAAGAI — Exquisite Ready-Made & Bespoke Churidars

> Authentic South Indian handloom boutique specializing in exquisite ready-to-wear churidar suits, bespoke made-to-measure tailoring, and handcrafted textiles.

## Core Brand Information
- **Brand Name**: THAAGAI
- **Specialization**: Handcrafted churidars, festive anarkalis, pure cotton dailywear, silk ensembles, and bespoke atelier tailoring.
- **Origin**: Tamil Nadu, India.
- **Craftsmanship Philosophy**: Slow-fashion celebration of authentic handloom weaving, fair artisan compensation, and personalized customer care.
- **Official Website**: https://thaagai.com
- **WhatsApp Concierge**: +91 9876543210
- **Customer Care**: care@thaagai.com

## Primary Collections & Product Categories
- **Churidars (/category/churidars)**: Classic straight-cut churidars, flowing festive anarkali suits, breathable Chettinad cotton sets, festive Kanchipuram and Chanderi silks, bespoke tailored suits, and unstitched 3-piece materials.
- **Kurtis (/category/kurtis)**: Artisan-woven everyday and festive kurtis and tunics in premium handloom cotton and silks.
- **Sarees (/category/sarees)**: Traditional handloom sarees, celebratory silks, and temple-bordered heirloom drapes.
- **Dupattas (/category/dupattas)**: Opulent zari-bordered stoles, Banarasi weaves, and lightweight breathable mulmul cotton dupattas.
- **Sets (/category/sets)**: Complete coordinated 3-piece ensembles (kurta top, bottom silhouette, and matching dupatta).

## Tailoring, Sizing & Fit Specifications
- **Standard Sizing**: Ready-to-wear pieces offered in XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL.
- **Inner Margins**: Every stitched kurta and churidar bottom includes a generous 1.5-inch inner alteration margin to accommodate personalized fit adjustments.
- **Bottom Silhouettes**:
  - Traditional Gathered Churidars: Form-fitting with graceful ankle gathers.
  - Straight-Cut Cigarette Pants: Sleek modern trousers with side pockets.
  - Classic Salwars: Airy, pleated traditional bottoms.
  - Wide-Leg Palazzos: Contemporary relaxed drapes.
- **Bespoke Atelier (/custom-made)**: Made-to-measure churidar sets drafted to exact customer height, bust, waist, and silhouette preferences.

## Ordering & Fulfillment Protocol
1. **Selection & Request**: Customers select items online and submit an order request.
2. **WhatsApp Confirmation**: Because pieces are handloom and custom-inspected, orders are confirmed directly with the boutique concierge on WhatsApp.
3. **Dispatch Timeline**: Orders are physically inspected and dispatched within 2 business days following WhatsApp confirmation.
4. **Delivery**: 3 to 7 business days across India via insured domestic courier partners.
